name: zvid_image_resample_square
description: zVid_Image::ResampleSquare resamples an image to a square size with nearest-source sampling, replaces the pixel buffer, optionally replaces the alpha map, and updates width/height.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target covers 0x46e9b0 yet, so tier S remains open.
Binary Ninja HLIL reuses a stack slot and renders the final alpha-map assignment as the height variable; assembly at 0x46ea1d and 0x46eb12 confirms the newly allocated alpha map is installed.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly at 0x46e9b0 computes x/y scale from source dimensions and sideLength, allocates sideLength*sideLength 16-bit pixels, allocates a matching alpha map only when the old alpha map is non-null, copies nearest-source pixels and alpha bytes with _ftol truncation, frees the old pixel buffer, writes the square width/height, installs the new pixel buffer, frees the old alpha map, and installs the new alpha map.
Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x46e9b0 has no warnings or tags and shows the same nearest-source sampling and owned-buffer replacement, with the documented stack-slot artifact around newAlphaMap.
The dependency frontier for 0x46e9b0 has no visible source blockers after accepting _ftol as compiler glue and malloc/free as CRT providers.

The native zvid_image_resample_square_smoke resamples a 4x2 image with pixels and alpha map to 2x2, verifies the expected sampled pixel and alpha values, verifies width/height update, and frees the replacement buffers.
